Commentary.Commentary: The England bowlers were up to the mark today. They executed their plans to perfection. Plunkett and Willey together were brilliant as they finished with combined figures of 8-0-35-2. Rashid provided good support. Jordan and Ball were a touch expensive but overall, Morgan will be happy with their effort. The wicket is a sluggish one but with the batting line-up England have, they should fancy themselves to chase this down.

So a big last over has seen India get to a total which is just above the average first innings score on this ground. England though will be happier of the two sides heading into the break. After winning the toss, they got off to the best possible start by picking three in the Powerplay. Raina and Kohli then steadied the ship with a 57-run stand but just as the two started looking dangerous, Rashid broke through. Kohli though continued but he too fell at the wrong time, three short of his half ton. But a quickfire 37-run stand between Pandya and Dhoni has given the visitors something to bowl at.

FOUR! Short and middled! Ball persisted with the same length again but MS is up to it. He swivels and powers it through the square leg fence. The fielder at fine leg did make an attempt to get near it but the speed on the ball evades him. 22 runs came off the last over as India end up with 148/5.
FOUR! Slapped! A bumper around off, Dhoni hangs back in his crease and pulls it straight past the bowler. The ball races to the long on boundary. This over has brought some happiness for India.
Shortish again from Ball, Pandya punches it to mid-wicket and gets a single from the free Hit.

Five runs! So many things happened on a single ball from Ball. He bowls a slower bumper and manages to evade the flashing blade of Pandya. However, Jos is undone by the bounce and fails to collect the ball behind the stumps. As a result, the ball goes to the boundary. And the irony is that, Jake Ball failed to keep his foot inside the line. He looks devastated by it. In the end, it's a no ball and four byes. Free Hit coming up.
Short in line of the stumps, Dhoni pulls it to mid-wicket and changes strike.
Wide! Down the leg side, left alone by MS. Wide signalled by the umpire.
FOUR! Dismissed! A shortish ball around off, Dhoni just stays it from his crease, slaps it with a straight bat and gets it past the fielder at mid off. A boundary results.
Jake comes back to bowl the last over of the innings and starts with a length ball. Dhoni works it deep square leg and takes quick two.
Brilliant comeback. A yorker again. Pandya digs it to mid on and takes two. 11 off the penultimate over of the innings.

SIX! Bang! This game is all about a few inches. Jordan understands that now. He looks to bowl another yorker but misses it by inches. Pandya gets under it and puts it way back into the long on stand for a maximum.
Wide outside off, Hardik misses to put bat to ball.
A yorker to back up the wider deliveries. Good bowling from Jordan. He is not allowing the Indian batters to get under the balls. Pandya can't do much other then digging it out back to the bowler.
Similar delivery from Jordan. MS hits it to mid off for another single.
Wide outside off, driven to mid off with power by MS. Liam there dives to his left but cannot stop the ball cleanly. As a result, two runs are stolen.
Similar delivery, Pandya chips it uppishly to the left side of the pitch and Willey makes a good diving save. A wicket and 4 off the 18th over.
Moves across to play the back of a length ball. He gets it to deep fine leg and scampers for a brace.
A bumper now from Willey. Pandya goes for the hook but misses it. He was looking at the umpire in anticipation of a wide but the umpire is unmoved.
A shortish delivery pulled away to mid-wicket for another run.
A short of a length on the pads, Pandya works it through square leg and opens his account with a single.
Hardik Pandya is the next man in for India.

OUT! What a catch from Root to send the Indian skipper packing. He was looking dangerous. A back of a length delivery on the hips from Willey, Kohli swivels and pulls it fine. The ball goes in the air and Root at fine leg takes a great catch diving forward. What a moment to pull off a blinder. India reeling at 111/5 with just 17 balls to go in the innings.
Another full toss around off, MS comes down the track but misses the ball altogether. A good over for India nonetheless.
Jordan corrects his line and bowls it wide outside off, Kohli drives it through covers for a single.

SIX! Shot! WOW! Just a mere flick of the wrists from Virat. A gentle full toss on the pads, Kohli hangs back in his crease and nonchalantly gets it up and over the square leg fence and into the crowd. India need a lot more of these.
Wide outside off once again. Jordan staying away from MS Dhoni's Radar. He still manages to get it through cover-point. One run taken.
Full outside off, played through covers for another run.
A low full toss in line of the stumps, Dhoni punches it to long on and takes a single.
Chris Jordan is back into the attack.
On the pads once again from David, Kohli flicks it to square leg and two runs are taken.
A touch too straight and MS misses the flick this time. The ball hits his pad and rolls to the on side. One leg bye is stolen.
On the hips, Kohli comes down the pitch once again and works it fine for a run.
Now comes down the track this time to play the length ball. He gets it to mid on and sets off for a run. Willey hares after it but couldn't stop them from taking two.
A bumper. Kohli makes some room to play it up and over the keeper's head but misses it.
A back of a length ball on the hips, Kohli pushes it through mid-wicket. The duo is quick between the wickets and as a result two runs are taken.
David Willey comes back into the attack.
Dhoni dances down the track and does well to block the ball. What a spell this has been from Adil. Only four from his last over. He too has impressive figures to his name. India 93/4 after 15 overs.

FOUR! And the helicopter is out. A tossed up delivery in line of the stumps, MS hangs back in his crease and just whips it from there The ball goes uppishly but in the gap between mid-wicket and long on.
A tad shortish in length, Dhoni pulls but finds the fielder once again at mid on. Pressure piling up now.
Pushed through outside off, MS misses the attempted cut. Three dot balls in a row.
A flighted ball around off, MS comes down the track and push it towards the cover fielder. Good stuff from leggie.
Faster on off, pushed to mid on off the back foot.
A dot to end the over! Full and on the slower side. Kohli hits it hard but finds the man at covers. Plunkett bowls out, he finishes with brilliant figures of 4-0-17-1.

Lovely running! We know how good these two are between the wickets. Also their understanding is right up there. Kohli with soft hands tucks this around the corner. He calls for two immediately and Dhoni has no hesitation in going and completing it.
Works this through mid-wicket for a run.
Better from Liam! He bowls it on a length and outside off, Dhoni guides it to point.

FOUR! Talk about piercing the gap to perfection. Dhoni has done exactly that. It is a nothing delivery. Short and on middle, too easy for Dhoni as he rocks back, rolls his wrists over the ball and pulls it between fine leg and deep backward square leg for a boundary.
Lands it on a length around off, Dhoni defends it onto the ground off the back foot.
Liam Plunkett is back on.
Wide outside off, cut behind point for another run. End of a successful over for Rashid.
Touch short outside off, Kohli opens the face of the bat and guides it to third man. A single results.
Flighted around middle, pushed to mid-wicket off the front foot for nothing.
Flatter in line of the stumps, MS works it to mid-wicket for a single.

OUT! Gone! Rashid has the last laugh. A loopy googly on off, Raina comes down the track and misses the line of the delivery. Buttler behind the wickets removes the bails to send Raina packing. The 57-run partnership is broken by the leg spinner. Timely wicket for England as the association started to look dangerous.
Flighted around middle and off, played to mid-wicket for nothing.
MS Dhoni comes to the crease.
Another single off the length ball to mid off from the front foot. 12 runs off this over.
on a length in line of the stumps, driven to mid on for a run.
Wide! Kohli tries flicking a ball that is down the leg side but misses. The umpire has signalled a wide.
Full around off, driven to mid on for a run.
Ball bangs this one in the middle of the pitch. Kohli pulls it and manages to keep it away from the fielder at square leg. One run is taken.
Around leg, flicked to fine leg for a run.

SIX! BANG! What a shot! Ball bowls a bumper around leg, Raina plays the full-blooded pull and clears the mid-wicket fence quiet easily. The left-hander gets into the act as well. This brings up the 50-run stand between the duo.
Jake Ball is into the attack.

SIX! Brilliant from Virat! He gets another floated ball in line of the stumps, lines it up and flat bats it down the ground. Jason Roy at long on runs to his left and reaches the ball in time, however, he fails to hold onto the catch. The decision is taking to the third umpire and a maximum is given. 15 runs taken off Adil's second over. Virat is accelerating now.
FOUR! A loopy delivery around off, Kohli hoick it across the line and evades the fielder at short mid-wicket. The ball races to the mid-wicket fence.
Another shortish delivery targeting the stumps, Raina pulls it to mid-wicket for another single.
A flatter ball around off, worked to third man for a single.
A touch short from Rashid. Virat powers it off the front foot to the mid-wicket region. Two runs are taken before Jonny cuts it out to his left.
A flighted ball around middle, Raina looks to hoick it across the line but gets it to mid-wicket for a run.
Raina is playing almost every ball the same way. He gets another length delivery targeting off, he moves across once again and gets it to fine leg. One run taken. Four singles off the over.
On a shortish length in line of the stumps, Virat punched it off the back foot towards mid-wicket for another single.
Back of a length in line of the stumps, Raina moves across his stumps, hops and and works it towards square leg for a run.
Full on the pads, worked off the front foot to square leg for a single.
On a length just outside off, Kohli looks to work it to third man but the extra bounce means the ball goes past the edge. Kohli looks surprised by it.
On a length around middle and off, pushed to mid off for nothing.
Liam Plunkett comes back for another spell.
Tossed up around middle, worked to the on side. Another run for Kohli. 7 runs taken off the Adil's first over.
Comes down the track and works it to mid-wicket. Two runs added to the total.
A touch short in length, Virat punches it off the back foot into the deep. The open vacant region towards square leg allows them to take two.
Loopy around middle and off, defended by Kohli.
Another flighted ball around off, Kohli pushes it through covers for two.
A flighted ball in line of the stumps, blocked off the front foot.
Adil Rashid comes in for a bowl.
Adil Rashid comes in for a bowl.
Wide outside off, slapped to point fro another single.
Raina guides it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Nice. A short ball targeting the grille of Kohli who pulls it to the deep and changes strike.
A touch too straight and on the pads. Raina works it off his pads towards fine leg and runs a single.
Shortish delivery in line of the stumps, punched to mid-wicket for a single.
Full around middle, pushed to mid-wicket for nothing.

FOUR! But still just 5 from the over! Just like the other five deliveries, this too is on the shorter side. Raina backs away and flat-bats it. It is not from the middle but still enough to clear the man at mid on and the ball races away for a much-needed boundary.
Good change of pace! The slower one outside off, Raina tries to guide it down to third man but misses. It goes on the bounce to the keeper.
A single, so just 1 from the 4 balls! This is on a length and slightly outside off, Kohli guides it down to third man and gets to the other end.
Three in a row! Again it is shorter in length around off, Kohli pushes it to covers.
Short and outside off, Kohli goes for the cut but is beaten by the extra bounce. Another dot.
Shorter in length on off, Kohli watchfully tucks it to mid-wicket.
A length ball in line of the stumps but it hits high on his thigh pad. An appeal ensue but the umpire ignores it.
Moves across and works the ball off his pads to square leg. A brace taken.
Raina shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Almost another chance here. Risky stuff from the Indian batters. A fullish ball on middle, Raina looks to hoick it but gets an inside edge. The ball hits his pads and rolls towards the fielder at mid off who has a shy at the stumps. The batsman would have made it in but just in time.
A touch short in line of the stumps, Raina gets on his toes and dabs it to mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Nicely done by Raina. He moves across his stumps and flicks the length ball fine to the fine leg boundary.
Chris Jordan comes in for a bowl.
Raina drives this through the covers. One run added to the total.
Suresh Raina makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! What? NO! Rahul, this is not done. Too adventurous perhaps. A length in line of the stumps. Rahul moves away from the stumps to make some room but misses it altogether. The ball kisses the bails and goes over the keeper head. England rejoice as India lose another.
On a length around off, driven to covers for nothing.
Virat Kohli comes to the crease.
Outside off, missed the cut.

OUT! Dhawan is run out in a very unfortunate manner. Liam bowls a short ball in line of the stumps, Dhawan looks to pull but gets hit on his elbow. The ball rolls to point and Rahul calls his partner through for a quick single. Dhawan who is in pain responds and rushes towards the non-striker's end where Roy releases the throw. The English skipper collects the ball and tries to whip the bails but he fails to do so in the first go. Still, he somehow manages to remove the bails with his right hand while the ball is in his left. Morgan's first reaction is that he has missed an opportunity as he looks to the heavens but then turns to appeal. The umpire goes upstairs. And the replays show that Dhawan lost his bat before dragging it in and his foot was still outside the line. And it seems that since Eoin was in touch with the ball while taking the bails off with his right hand, the third umpire has given him that benefit of doubt. Debatable. End of Dhawan's innings, his sorry record against England in this format continues...
The decision has been referred to the third umpire. It seems Dhawan is out of his crease as he lost his bat while dragging it in. Will he survive?
Wide outside off, Dhawan throws his bat at it and gets an under edge to the keeper.
Liam Plunkett is the first change for England.
Another short delivery and another pull from Dhawan. A run taken from the square leg region.
FOUR! Streaky! Short and pulled by Dhawan. The ball goes to Hales at square leg but it makes a mess of it. Which should have been a single ends up being a four. Dhawan won't be complaining though.
Short of a length around off, guided to third man for another one.
Shikhar moves across his stumps this time, looking to hoick the short ball. Drags it to square leg and changes strike.
KL waits for the length ball and guides it to third man for a run.
Back of a length in line of the stumps, dabbed to point for a single.
OOH! And Willey rolls his fingers on this one. Rahul goes fishing to the ball outside off and misses it. Another good over from David. He is keeping it tight.
Dhawan is looking to tackle the swing by coming down the track and he has been successful till now. A length ball on middle, Dhawan takes few steps and punches it to mid off. A run taken.
Class! So pure and elegant. Willey bowls this outside off on a length, KL goes towards the ball and just pushes it through cover-point. The ball is stopped inside the fence and a single is saved.
Comes down the track and pushes the full ball to mid off for a single.

Willey is moving the ball nicely. A fullish delivery on middle and leg, Dhawan looks to flick it but misses. The ball hits him on his pad and the bowlers appeals straightaway. The umpire is not interested.
Full, swinging in and KL gets an inside edge to fine leg for a run.
KL Rahul is the next batsman in.

OUT! In the air... and gone! He never looked comfortable. Ball has his first with a shortish delivery. He angles this into the body of the batsman who goes for the pull but the bounce does him in. It takes the top edge and goes high in the air. Jos calls for it and completes the catch behind the wicket. India lose their first and England are having a 'Ball' with the ball.
Rohit goes for the hook but misses the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Rohit goes after the 'Ball'. A half-volley outside off, Sharma throws his bat at it and pierces the gap between covers and mid off for his and innings' first boundary.
Similar line and length, Dhawan clips it to mid-wicket and changes strike.
On a length in line of the stumps, blocked from the crease.
Starts his T20I career with a back of length ball on the pads, Rohit misses it and gets hit on his thigh pad. The ball goes to the on side and the batsmen steals a leg bye.
Jake Ball is into the attack from the other end.
Full on leg, Dhawan comes down the track and punches it straight to mid off for nothing. Good over from Willey first up.

And he looks to be innovative off the very next ball. A straightish delivery on a length, Rohit moves across and goes down on his knee. He was looking to play the ramp shot but ended up getting hit on his gloves and then on the pads. The players make a huge appeal as the ball rolls to the off side and the batsmen scamper for a run. The umpire shakes his head. Willey looks at Morgan for the review but they choose against it.

An absolute jaffa! How did that miss the off stump or the edge? Another length ball on off, the ball swings in the air and goes away after pitching. Sharma comes forward for a push but he is squared up altogether.
On a length on middle, defended off the front foot.
Oh! A play and a miss. Nice line again, outside off, enticing Rohit to go after it, which he does but misses.
Starts with a nice inswinging delivery in line of the stumps. Rohit blocks it off the front foot.
We are ready. The players are out in the middle. Shikhar Dhawan and Rohit Sharma is the opening partnership for India. While the left-arm pacer David Willey will take the new ball for England.

The India captain, Virat Kohli starts by saying he would have bowled first as well. Further adds the track looks good and the pressure is on England to win this one. Mentions the idea was to let them play the spinners first and analyze what to do. Adds that they are playing fearless cricket, they are a young side and they are enjoying each others company. Ends by saying it's a challenge to bowl on smallish ground for the spinner, its a challenge to their character and he hopes they come good once again for them.

The England captain, Eoin Morgan says that he is looking to bowl first and put the pressure on India. Asserts that he would like to chase on a small ground. Adds that Jake ball makes his debut in this game and replaces Moeen Ali in the playing XI. Further adds that they need to get into their own and give it all as it is a must win game for them. Ends by saying that it's a contest between seam bowling and spin bowling.
Toss - England win the toss and elect to bowl.

Kuldeep Yadav was the main destroyer in the first match for the visitors, however, the hosts were not able to counter the other bowlers effectively either. The Men in Blue, on the other hand, look settled with the team Virat Kohli has decided to go ahead with. His problems diminished, even more, when KL Rahul played a ballistic inning in the previous encounter between the two. The likes of Shikhar Dhawan and other batsmen would also like to stay in the middle for a longer time if the opportunity arises. Nonetheless, it's going to be a power-packed game. The action starts in a while, keep a cuppa coffee handy and hang around!

Hello and welcome to the second T20I between England and India at Sophia Gardens, Cardiff. The home team is hoping that their luck turns as bright and sunny as the weather here in the south-western region of their country. It's an important contest considering that the series is at stake and also their pride is at stake. They would like the in-form Jason Roy, Jonny Bairstow along with other batters to come into their own as quickly as possible and fight back against the dangerous looking Indian bowling line-up.
